candidates.name: Lymphoma
support_spans: revealed patchy areas of large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis
infiltration of lung parenchyma by malignant neoplasm
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with worsening dyspnea, unintentional weight loss, and the presence of a hilar mass, along with the biopsy results showing atypical lymphoid cells and a malignant neoplasm, are consistent with lymphoma.

candidates.name: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
support_spans: revealed patchy areas of large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis
marked FDG-avid uptake at the lung lesion, right neck lymph node, and left acetabular bone marrow
candidates.why: The presence of large atypical lymphoid cells, necrosis, and the marked FDG-avid uptake in multiple areas are suggestive of an aggressive lymphoma, such as diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

candidates.name: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma
support_spans: revealed patchy areas of large atypical lymphoid cells with necrosis
infiltration of lung parenchyma by malignant neoplasm, mixed inflammatory infiltrate
candidates.why: The patient's presentation and biopsy results are consistent with non-Hodgkin lymphoma, which can present with a wide range of symptoms and can involve multiple organs.
